name: InternVL: Scaling up Vision Foundation Models and Aligning for Generic Visual-Linguistic Tasks
problem: Vision foundation models lagged language models in scale, capping multimodal capability.
mechanism: Scales the VISION foundation model to 6B parameters and progressively aligns it with the LLM using web-scale image-text data, with dynamic resolution and tiled high-resolution input fed through a pixel-shuffle-style MLP projector. Intended as a drop-in open alternative to ViT-22B.
notes: Venue CVPR 2024 (crossref container '2024 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition'). The InternVL lineage is where vision-token reduction is most systematically engineered - its own successor (pap record internvl-x) and many successors attack token count directly, which is a sign the base design's token cost was felt as a practical problem rather than an academic one. Dynamic tiling plus pixel shuffle is the same trade as LLaVA-NeXT anyres: resolution for accuracy, paid for in tokens.
